messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — release window in ~2h, hotfix for inference autoscaler
lina: Our MFA provider is experiencing short delays; need to confirm who can press in case canaries fail
sam: can we delay? or is this urgent?
anita: hotfix is urgent, it reverts a regression causing OOMs on dedicated clusters
ryan: is this covered by the usual deploy rota? I don't see an on-call presser listed
lina: rota says @tom is on-call but he is traveling. asking if we can grant temporary press to @maria for this window
deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: Reminder: pressers must have active MFA and be listed in deployers group. Automatic rollback enabled for failing canaries.
maria: I can take it, but I don't currently have the 'deployer' role in prod — I only have staging.
anita: ops-bot, can we give a 2h jIT grant to maria? MFA still required but we can whitelist one-time delta for provider latency
ops-bot: Ops-bot: Please provide an approval ticket id and TTL. JIT grants require a recorded justification and an owner.
lina: Ticket INF-4721 created: "hotfix autoscaler revert — temporary deployer for maria". TTL 2h. reason in ticket.
ops-bot: Ops-bot: Granting temporary role: command to run:
```
grant-temp-press --user maria --ttl 2h --ticket INF-4721 --require-mfa:true
```
ops-bot: Role granted. Please confirm MFA status.
maria: MFA prompt failed first time (provider delay) but succeeded on retry. I have the role now.
sam: who will pin the release/version? we should pin the canary build if we roll forward quickly.
lina: We'll pin to v2.4.1-hotfix. Release note: revert faulty commit 9f3c1d.
ryan: Add this to release notes and to the rollback playbook. Also set deploy-bot arg --no-auto-bump so we don't accidentally roll to latest.
maria: Ready to press. Will run the gated canary then full roll if green. I'll run:
```
/deploy run release-v2.4.1-hotfix --pin v2.4.1-hotfix --canary 10% --timeout 15m
```
maria: starting canary now :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: Canary started for release-v2.4.1-hotfix by maria. Monitoring metrics channel: #prod-metrics. Auto-rollback on error is enabled.
maria: canary looks good after 7m, latency stable, no OOM spikes :thumbsup:
maria: proceeding to full rollout
maria: full rollout complete, all targets at v2.4.1-hotfix
lina: thanks everyone. I'll update INF-4721 with postmortem notes and close the JIT grant
ops-bot: Ops-bot: JIT grant for maria will expire at +2h as requested
tom: thanks for covering, and nice quick coordination :clap:
